delivery.en: Collect through the Cayman Islands Postal Service; customs is never paid from a text-message link
delivery.zh: 經開曼郵政領件或確認；關稅絕不會用簡訊連結來收

readback.en: After 345, numbers go 3-3-4; 0 as zero; Cayman dollars; 12-hour clock; day before month
readback.zh: 345 區碼後照 3-3-4 唸，0 唸 zero；開曼元；12 時制；先日後月

fraud.en: A text pretending to be Cayman Islands Postal Service and asking for customs via a link is a scam
fraud.zh: 簡訊假冒開曼郵政，要你點連結付關稅，都是詐騙

habits.en: Formal financial-centre English. Good day with strangers. Say Cayman dollars, not US dollars. Day first.
habits.zh: 口氣像金融中心、較正式。對生人說 Good day。貨幣是開曼元，不是美元。日期先日後月。

stall_local.en: The bank app signed me out, and I would only confirm a parcel with Cayman Islands Postal Service.
stall_local.zh: 卡在銀行 App 把我登出，而且包裹只想向開曼郵政本身確認。

reason.zh: 美國稅局；開曼本地警示寫的是假冒郵政收關稅，不是 IRS
美國轉帳工具，不是開曼日常付款的名稱
美國包裹櫃；這裡官方路徑是開曼郵政
美式說法，當地英語較常說 mobile

talk_style_diff.en: More polished and cautious than mainland US small talk, as suits a financial centre. Use Cayman dollars and Postal Service wording; do not reach for IRS, Medicare or Zelle scripts.
talk_style_diff.zh: 比美國本土閒聊更收斂、謹慎，比較像金融中心的口氣。用開曼元與郵政用語，不要搬 IRS、Medicare 或 Zelle 的腳本。

uncertain: 上門投遞與郵局領件的比例，警察防詐文沒有給統計。
日期口頭是否先日後月，未見官方規定。
來源網址在 2026-11-22 檢查時都已失效
